description_en: Configures the Simple Log Service (SLS) or Object Storage Service (OSS) export information. The configuration is unique at the instance level and can be configured once and used multiple times
description_zh: 配置导出的SLS 或者OSS 信息，实例级别唯一，遵循一次配置多次使用的原则
name: ConfigureResultExport

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to view the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: Exports data to SLS.
OSS: Exports data to OSS
parameters.help_zh:
导出类型，枚举类型，当前可选值为：

SLS：标识导出目的为SLS。
OSS：标识导出目的为OSS
parameters.name: export_type

fields.help_en: The expiration time of the temporary Logstore generated for result set export. Unit: days. The Logstore is automatically deleted after expiration. The minimum value is 1 day and the maximum value is 30 days. An error is returned if the value is out of range
fields.help_zh:
结果集导出临时生成的logstore的过期时间，单位为天，过期后自动删除。
最小1天，最大30天，超过范围报错
fields.name: logstore_ttl

fields.help_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed
fields.help_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称
fields.name: resource_group

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS project
fields.name: sls_project

parameters.help_en: The SLS configuration information when the export destination is SLS
parameters.help_zh: 当导出目的为SLS类型时，对应的SLS配置信息
parameters.name: sls_info

fields.help_en: The OSS path where the export results are stored
fields.help_zh: 导出结果存储的OSS路径地址
fields.name: export_base_path

fields.help_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed
fields.help_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称
fields.name: resource_group

fields.help_en: The expiration time of the OSS file. Unit: days. The minimum value is 1 day and the maximum value is 30 days. An error is returned if the value is out of range
fields.help_zh: Oss文件过期时间，单位为天，最小1天，最大30天，超出范围报错
fields.name: result_file_ttl

parameters.help_en: The OSS configuration information when the export destination is OSS
parameters.help_zh: 当导出目的为OSS类型时，对应的OSS配置信息
parameters.name: oss_info

Data.description_en: The configured result set export information
Data.description_zh: 已配置的结果集导出信息

ExportType.description_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: Exports data to SLS.
OSS: Exports data to OSS
ExportType.description_zh:
导出类型，枚举类型，返回结果可能值为：

SLS：标识导出目的为SLS。
OSS：标识导出目的为OSS

OssInfo.description_en: The OSS export information configured when the export destination is OSS
OssInfo.description_zh: 当导出目的为OSS类型时，配置成功的OSS导出信息

ExportBasePath.description_en: The OSS path where the export results are stored
ExportBasePath.description_zh: 导出结果存储的OSS路径地址

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称

ResultFileTtl.description_en: The expiration time of the OSS file. Unit: days. The minimum value is 1 day and the maximum value is 30 days
ResultFileTtl.description_zh: Oss文件过期时间，单位为天，最小1天，最大30天

SlsInfo.description_en: The SLS configuration information when the export destination is SLS
SlsInfo.description_zh: 当导出目的为SLS类型时，对应的SLS配置信息

LogstoreTtl.description_en: The expiration time of the temporary Logstore generated for result set export. Unit: days. The Logstore is automatically deleted after expiration. The minimum value is 1 day and the maximum value is 30 days
LogstoreTtl.description_zh: 结果集导出临时生成的logstore的过期时间，单位为天，过期后自动删除。 最小1天，最大30天

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称

SlsProject.description_en: The name of the SLS project

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP请求返回的响应状态码，200表示请求发送成功

Message.description_en:
The additional information about the call result. Description:

If the request is normal, OK is returned.
If the request is abnormal, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：

请求正常，返回OK。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功，取值说明：
true：成功。
false：失败
